decisions.decision: Replaced upfront 5.7MB desc-entity-lookup.json fetch with lazy Pagefind-based expandability checks
decisions.rationale: Initial sync load was the primary slowness culprit. Pattern matches entity.js which already uses lazy Pagefind lookup.

decisions.decision: All graph node radii and font sizes converted to screen-space (divided by globalScale)
decisions.rationale: force-graph pre-applies the zoom transform to ctx; world-coord sizes get scaled, making 12px circles render at 100+px when zoom is high.

decisions.decision: Added nodePointerAreaPaint with matching screen-space hit areas
decisions.rationale: Without it, force-graph default hit detection uses world coords and misses the tiny screen-space circles, breaking clicks.

decisions.decision: Tooltip restructured to match entity.js pattern (title as anchor link, action button in graph-tooltip-actions wrapper, appended async after expandability resolves)
decisions.rationale: Original concatenated DesplegarVer descripción was a CSS layout failure; entity.js pattern is the canonical Zasqua tooltip style.

decisions.decision: Added compactMode flag to EntityExplorer that suppresses inline facet column when sidebar-facets exists
decisions.rationale: Wave 3 extracted facets to top sidebar but EntityExplorer.render() still built its own facet column, causing duplicate facets.

decisions.decision: Replaced graphInstance.refresh() (does not exist on standalone force-graph) with _redraw() helper that re-applies graphData
decisions.rationale: TypeError was breaking handleHover, applyFilters, clearFilters, loadMoreDocs.

decisions.decision: Fixed rebuildAdjacency this-scope bug — was using function(l){this.nodeNeighbours} where this was undefined
decisions.rationale: Critical: silent throw after every addNodesToGraph call broke adjacency entirely, which broke hover dimming, filter application, expansion, and pruning. This was the root cause of multiple visible symptoms (flashing nodes, disappearing entities).

context_notes: Phase 10.1 implements an infinite bipartite graph explorer replacing the curated 100-node graph. Plans 01-03 are committed on main. Plan 04 is human verification checkpoint. Multiple critical bugs found and fixed during verification: (1) refresh() does not exist on standalone force-graph, (2) rebuildAdjacency had a this-scope bug, (3) all node sizes were in world coords instead of screen coords, (4) tooltip rendered concatenated buttons, (5) facets duplicated, (6) 5.7MB sync fetch at init. All fixes deployed to _site/js but NOT yet committed. Server is fast (HAR confirms). User reports browser still crashes — needs fresh-context debugging. Critical background warning: any full-92k-entity Pagefind sort (e.g. pagefind.search(null, {sort: ...})) takes 24+ seconds and hangs the WASM thread for that duration.
